sources.snippet: HEP Chat Entrypoint This repository contains ready-to-run inference entry points for HEP chat models. Models are listed in models.json, so new trained models can be added without rewriting the app, terminal chat, batch runner, or download helper. The default configured model is: hep-qwen2.5-7b-lora16-sigbg-irred-red-step2200
